title: Terms of Service
intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of AffProf ("Service"), operated by Carlos Sanchez operating as AffProf, based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: 1. Eligibility
sections.content:
• You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service.
• You must provide accurate information when registering.
• You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.
• One person may not maintain multiple Free accounts.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.content:
AffProf provides link management tools including:
• Short link generation and redirection
• QR code generation and customization
• Automated link health monitoring
• Click analytics and reporting
• Custom domain support (Pro plan)

sections.heading: 3. Plans, Trials, and Billing
sections.content:
Free plan
• No payment required. No credit card required.
• Subject to feature and quantity limits described on the Pricing page.
• We may modify Free plan limits with reasonable notice.

Pro plan
• Billed monthly or annually via Stripe.
• A 14-day free trial is available. The trial requires a valid payment method, which you authorize us to charge automatically when the trial ends unless you cancel beforehand.
• Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing period unless cancelled.
• You may cancel at any time from your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period; you keep Pro access until then.
• We reserve the right to change pricing with at least 30 days notice to existing subscribers.

Refund policy
• We offer a full refund on your first paid charge if you request it within 7 days of that charge. Email hello@affprof.com to request your refund.
• After this 7-day window, we do not offer refunds for partial billing periods.
